_comment: Single source of truth for the functions. The script sends it to Gemini in the setup message (stripping x-* and _* keys) and uses it to validate tool calls exactly like the firmware will. x-range keys are numeric constraints enforced on the device only.

functionDeclarations.name: brew
functionDeclarations.description: Brew a drink. Use it whenever the user asks to make, prepare or brew something. Omit every parameter the user did not mention: the machine will use the saved settings for that drink. Never convert to millilitres or degrees: use only the provided levels.

drink.description: Drink to brew. A generic 'a coffee' = coffee; 'an espresso' = espresso; 'ristretto' = ristretto.

strength.description: Aroma strength from 1 to 5 (the machine's strength bars). strong/intense = 4, very strong = 5, mild/light = 2, very mild = 1. 'Stronger than usual' = saved value + 1 (read it with get_drink_settings).

coffee_length.description: Amount of coffee in the cup. short/small/little = short; long/lengthened/generous = long; very long/big cup/mug = extra_long.

milk_amount.description: Milk drinks only. less milk/darker = less; more milk/lighter/creamier = more.

temperature.description: very hot/piping hot = high; warm/not too hot/for kids = low.

extra_shot.description: true when the user asks for a 'double' meaning a stronger single cup (additional shot).

cups.description: Number of cups: 'two coffees' = 2. If 'double' is ambiguous (two cups or stronger) ask the user.

functionDeclarations.name: brew_saved
functionDeclarations.description: Brew a saved drink: 'the usual' / 'my favourite' = favorite; 'same as before' / 'another one' / 'do it again' = last.

functionDeclarations.name: stop
functionDeclarations.description: Immediately stop the brewing in progress. Use it as soon as the user says stop, enough, halt, that's too much.

functionDeclarations.name: get_drink_settings
functionDeclarations.description: Read the saved settings of a drink (strength, length, milk, temperature). Use it before relative adjustments such as 'stronger than usual' or when the user asks how a drink is configured.

functionDeclarations.name: save_drink_settings
functionDeclarations.description: Permanently save the settings of a drink ('from now on', 'always', 'set my coffee longer') or save it as the favourite. First call with confirmed=false, repeat to the user what will change, and call again with confirmed=true only after an explicit yes.

as_favorite.description: true to save it as 'the usual'.

functionDeclarations.name: get_machine_status
functionDeclarations.description: Machine status: water tank, beans, drip tray, grounds container, water filter, descaling, brewing in progress. Use it when the user asks how the machine is doing or why it does not work.

functionDeclarations.name: start_maintenance
functionDeclarations.description: Start a maintenance procedure. First call with confirmed=false to get what is needed (e.g. water, descaler, container), explain it to the user, and call again with confirmed=true only after an explicit yes.
